scripts.text: You have too many kinds of objects. Try to continue after reducing those objects.
You have too many heavy objects. Try to continue after reducing your weight.

scripts.speaker: Albo
scripts.text:
Who are you?
We don't need a weaking!!

scripts.speaker: Albo
scripts.text:
We crossed the sea!
We are great heroes of Culvert! We do not forgive the seafood that aims at Culvert!

scripts.speaker: Albo
scripts.text: We used to be the henchmen of Mr. Missing! We almost became guards of such a historic site.

scripts.speaker: Albo
scripts.text: However, when sea water flooded all precious the resources, my dream... all my dreams melted away...

scripts.speaker: Albo
scripts.text: We do not forgive the seafood that invaded our territory. I'll eat them with spicy paste!!!
^0000ffAlbo's voice shakes with anger. He smacked his lips when he mentioned spicy paste.^000000

scripts.speaker: Albo
scripts.text: That task is really hard for you, so I can't tell you about it. Why don't you find another one?

scripts.speaker: Albo
scripts.text: I'm sorry. There is no new task yet! If I find any work, I'll tell you so!

scripts.speaker: Albo
scripts.text: Uh!? Where is the task? Let me find that quickly. You must speak with Madeca!

scripts.speaker: Albo
scripts.text:
Today, the heroes of Culvert!
We raise our voices and set a date for the extermination of ^0000ff{0}^000000!

scripts.speaker: Albo
scripts.text: Come on, heroes! Don't be afraid of them! Just go on, since it's a one-day mission!

scripts.speaker: Albo
scripts.text: I'll give you one week to finish this job! Terminate all of them in Culvert Dungeon, Normal Mode!

scripts.speaker: Albo
scripts.text: I'll give you one week to finish this job! Terminate all of them in Culvert Dungeon, Hard Mode!
You received a request for the Extermination of ^005500{0}^000000. If you need more details, please check the quest window.
You have too many kinds of objects. Try to continue after reducing those objects.
You have too many heavy objects. Try to continue after reducing your weight.

scripts.speaker: Madeca
scripts.text:
Karrrrrrr!!
Let's have some bad seafood that can be boiled or grilled!

scripts.speaker: Madeca
scripts.text: Who are you? You are such a totterer. Even seaweed could kill you!

scripts.speaker: Madeca
scripts.text:
Oh?
You're the one who took care of my big brother Albo's request. It was a hard job!
What are you doing here?
General Culvert Daily Service Compensation
Hard Culvert Daily Service Compensation
General Culvert Weekly Service Compensation
Hard Culvert Weekly Service Compensation

scripts.speaker: Madeca
scripts.text: I'm here to help my big brother Albo!

scripts.speaker: Madeca
scripts.text: We provide precious materials to humans who make sludge out of the bad seafood in the Culverts!

scripts.speaker: Madeca
scripts.text: We provide A~B Grade Coins as compensation for daily service, and the precious Sea God's Wrath as compensation for weekly service.

scripts.speaker: Madeca
scripts.text: If you take care of big brother Albo's request, I will see you very often. So, let's stay close!

scripts.speaker: Madeca
scripts.text: I can't give you compensation for an expired request, so let me check if any of yours have expired.

scripts.speaker: Madeca
scripts.text: Something is wrong. Please check this again!

scripts.speaker: Madeca
scripts.text: I don't see any completed mission!

scripts.speaker: Madeca
scripts.text: Um, I'm sorry. You exceeded the time limit, so I can't give you any payment.

scripts.speaker: Madeca
scripts.text:
You've punished ^0000ff{0}^000000!
Here's your pay!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Are you talking to me?!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text:
I'm not sure what made you come here but you can't enter!
Tomas' orders...
^770099You must be Base level 90 to enter.^000000

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: (trembling)
^660066This cat looks like it's in bad shape. It is slightly trembling.^000000
Pet the cat
Are you ok?

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Are you talking to me?!
^660066A trembling cat is looking up at you.^000000

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Achoo!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text:
We have had many issues during the
cleaning of the culverts. But a
cat's gotta do it...
What culvert are you cleaning?

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text:
It might look unfamiliar for an
outsider, but actually this place
is made to keep souvenirs and
luxurious things.

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text:
After there was a big trembling on
this island, things started leaking
around here. So that's why I became
a cleaner here, though I used
to be a manager.
^660066The cat looks like it's been crying...^000000

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text:
There is a culvert along this way
to the basement. There are many bad
guys who hurt me. I am tired of
fighting with them so many times a
day!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text:
Ohh! You touched my fur!
My fur is falling out... it's all
those guys' fault~
^660066You just now notice that the cat's fur is missing in some places.^000000
Why don't you just quit!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: I still have to make a living, don't I?

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text:
Sometimes I can get a lucky box,
or even better, I can get cans...
Okay, cheers!
I will help if possible...

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Thank you. I am going back to pour the water!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text:
(turns down his voice)
If you really want to help, come closer!
(get in closer)

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text:
Not everyone can be an assistant
here. But I can't help choosing
anyone at the moment...

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: If you want to go down here, let me get this code.
^660066The cat scribbles a memo for code to you.^000000
Open the memo.
^660000Aragam insulted me.^000000

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text:
You must be here with friends
because you can't go in alone! And
the password code will be from the
party leader!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text:
What is also important is you must
have a Seagod Protection with you.

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text:
Don't forget! I will not open the
door if you do not have Seagod Protection!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: You don't look like you have Seagod Protection. I can't open door at the moment!

^0000ffYou have to organize a party of
more than 1 member or be a member
of the party and come back.^000000

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Ummm? What's up? Tell me the password if you're the leader!
No... nothing.
Aragam insulted me.
Enter the Culvert.

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: What a rookie.

After making the reservation, you
have to select Enter the Culvert.
Enter Culvert
Cancel

Enter Culvert
Cancel

An unknown error has occurred.

The gate to the Culvert is still closed.

Only party members can participate.

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: I am trying to have a conversation with your leader now. Please don't disturb and wait!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: This is the underground culvert where you will clean with your friends!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: I'll open the door first. By the way, do you know how to fight?
I'm pretty good at delivering bread.
I know how to fight.
^ffffffGive me the diamond.^000000

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Ok then, I'll let you clean the culverts here as usual! I will prepare at the right-hand corner, please follow me!
Wait! I changed my mind!
As you wish~

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Huh? Not ready yet? Talk to me again when you're ready.

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Hmmm... Missing thinks you're weak! Tell me the truth!!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Huh? You have some fighting skills? Well, then, there is one place I wasn't able to clean... why don't you go there?!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: I must tell you that it's been such a long~~ time since we've cleaned that place, so anyone under level 140 cannot even enter! Are you sure you still want to go?
Wait! I changed my mind!
Sure, I'm prepared already~

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Hmm? Talk to me again when you're ready.

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: I told you not to play with me~!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: I will tell you how to clean shortly. Can you see the culverts around you?
What culverts??
Yes, I see them.

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Huh? Is this your first time seeing culverts? You'll see many buried machines in the ground. You may look around and come back!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: That's right! Those culverts are very important! We must clean the culverts to prevent seaweed from blocking them. This is what we, cleaners, do!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Watch out! Some monsters will be after you while you're cleaning the culverts! But do not yield to them!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: And... NEVER let 6 seaweeds stack! Up to 5 is acceptable! If there are 6, I'll drag you out of here!!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: I don't care if you get help from your friends or not. I want you to clean up all culverts! Don't forget! I will watch you and give you instructions. Just do what I said!!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Once your leader finishes preparing, it will begin, so get your hearts ready for it!!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: So, are you ready to clean now?
Wait! Not yet!
Let's start!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Huh? Not ready yet? Then talk to me when you're ready.

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: OK! Now it begins!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: I have the cleaning job for 40 years and I've never seen such a terrible team!!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: I see seaweed everywhere because you're wiggling! All the culverts will be blocked with seaweed!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Once your leader finishes preparing, settlement will be decided so get your hearts ready for it!!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: If you got some guts to challenge again, I'll give you another chance! What's your choice going to be!?
Wait! Not yet!
Okay, let's start again!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: You're still slow! Talk to me again whenever your're ready.

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: Ok! Let's start now!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: I was very surprised!!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: That funny-looking fish seems to be one of Coelacanths living around here. This is my first time seeing one coming here alone!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: I'll clean up the remains. Go pack and leave! Enterance is located on the other side, look for it!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: You've destroyed an immense monster!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: The one you destroyed was among the variety of Coelacanths. Others have tried to destroy them but failed.

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: I'll clean up the remains. You go ahead to get trophies and leave!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: One more thing! DO NOT TALK to ANYONE about what you've seen here today!!

scripts.speaker: Missing, the Cleaner
scripts.text: If Tomas closes this down, we will lose our jobs!
